name: Strategic Entrepreneurship
description:
This course contains the following topics:
Introduction to Strategic Entrepreneurship
Entrepreneurial Opportunity Identification and Evaluation.
Integration of Entrepreneurship, Innovation, and Strategy into a coherent firm approach.
Strategic entrepreneurship: a way towards competitive advantage through Strategic Renewal and Transformation
Strategic Entrepreneurship in Emerging Technologies & Digital Contexts
Pitfalls, failure patterns, and resilience strategies.
